properties.site-address: Former play area, Cheveral Road, Bedworth
properties.notes: The site was a former garage site that was demolished and changed to a play area. The play area has now been demolished and the site is part grass/ part concrete.. Site assessed as being deliverable in the SHLAA 2016. Allocated as a proposed Non-strategic site in the Borough Plan 2011-2031 Publication (2017)
